label: AutoMod
tagline: Catch scams, IP-grabbers and raid spam before your mods do.
description: AutoMod keeps an eye on chat for harmful messages and raid floods, so your mods can enjoy the stream too. Depending on how serious a message is, it can warn the sender, remove the message, or hand out a timeout or ban. VIPs, mods and you are always exempt, and anything borderline is left to your human mods. Pick a level from None to All, then adjust each check below. A small safety floor (hate slurs and IP-grabber links) stays on at every level, even with the module off, because that content can put your channel and the bot at risk on Twitch. The rest is up to you.

level.label: Enforcement level
level.help: Sets the default for every check below. The safety floor applies at every level.

harassment.label: Harassment
harassment.help: Messages meant to hurt someone: the sender gets a warning and the message is removed. If it keeps happening, a timeout comes next, then a ban.

sexual.label: Sexual content
sexual.help: Removes messages with explicit sexual terms.

profanity.label: Profanity
profanity.help: Removes plain swearing. Off by default: most channels allow it.

style.label: Caps & symbol spam
style.help: Removes shouting, symbol walls and character floods. Emote walls (KEKW spam) are recognized and never flagged.

links.label: Link-spam radar
links.help: Watches for the same link template posted by many different accounts and removes the wave. Single links are never touched.

clips_only.label: Twitch clips only
clips_only.help: Removes messages that contain any link other than a Twitch clip (clips.twitch.tv/… or twitch.tv/…/clip/…). Off by default: turn on when chat should only share clips.

block_terms.label: Blocked terms
block_terms.help: Extra words or phrases to flag in your channel. Separate with commas or new lines. Matched even through obfuscation (l33t, look-alike letters).

allow_terms.label: Allowed terms
allow_terms.help: Words that are fine in your channel: a line containing one is never flagged by the checks above or your blocked terms. Cannot override the safety floor.
